facts.fact: The Ministry of Information and Communication Technology contributed N$115 million over three years towards the Universal Service Fund, per CRAN's report for the year to 31 March 2025.

The Fund was established under section 56 of the Communications Act with levy regulations finalised, was officially launched on 19 March 2025 with N$115 million from the Ministry over three years, and its first bidding round allocated almost N$31 million of capital subsidies to MTC for nine sites.

note: CRAN's own regulatory levy income (N$25.5m loss year) is the regulator's licence income, not assigned to digital programmes: other, no fact. The page gives N$115m, whereas The Brief gives N$145m for the same event.
